sn46.5:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkhami || la [pe] || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn46.5:1.4: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti || ||
sn46.5:1.5: Bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgā ti vuccanti || || 3.
sn46.5:1.6: Idha bhikkhu bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggaparināmiṃ || la [pe] ||
sn46.5:1.7: upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossagapariṇamiṃ || 4.
sn46.5:1.8: Tassime satta bojjhaṅge bhāvayato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati || bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati || avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati ||
sn46.5:1.10: khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || 5.
sn46.5:1.11: Bodhāya saṃvattantī ti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgā ti vuccantī
